name: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Monte in Braga
description: Above the northern Portuguese city of Braga, this hillside pilgrimage sanctuary turns Mount Espinho into a stage-set Jerusalem. Visitors climb a zigzagging Baroque stairway, rising 116 metres past chapels with scenes from the Passion, fountains, statues and gardens, to a whitewashed granite church finished in 1811. The Stairway of the Five Senses is its showpiece, set in leafy woodland.
